desc.extract: Reads each chunk of a document and pulls out entities and relationships, then merges them into the graph.
desc.vlm: Describes images found in documents and emails so they can be searched.
desc.keyword: Turns each question into search keywords before looking in the graph.
desc.query: Writes the answer from what retrieval found. It is usually the most expensive purpose per token.

opsNote.extract: Tables and equations count here, not under Vision. Deletes can spend tokens too.

opsNote.keyword: Small, but a useful early signal of traffic. /query/data runs this with no answer written.
opsNote.query: Open WebUI title requests count here because they use the Query model.

setting.EXTRACT_LLM_MODEL: The model. Falls back to LLM_MODEL when not set.
setting.MAX_GLEANING: Extra passes over each chunk. Lower saves tokens but may miss entities.
setting.CHUNK_SIZE: Larger chunks mean fewer calls but bigger prompts.
setting.FORCE_LLM_SUMMARY_ON_MERGE: How many descriptions it takes to trigger a summary.
setting.ENABLE_LLM_CACHE_FOR_EXTRACT: Reuses earlier results when a document is reprocessed.
setting.VLM_LLM_MODEL: The model. It must support images.
setting.VLM_PROCESS_ENABLE: Turns vision on or off for documents and emails.
setting.VLM_MIN_IMAGE_PIXEL: Skips tiny images, in documents and emails.
setting.VLM_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES: Largest image sent, in documents and emails.
setting.KEYWORD_LLM_MODEL: The model. A small, fast one is usually enough.
setting.ENABLE_LLM_CACHE: Reuses the result when the same question is asked again.
setting.QUERY_LLM_MODEL: The model. Usually the largest cost decision.
setting.MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS: Upper limit on context for each answer.
setting.TOP_K: How many entities and relationships are retrieved.
setting.CHUNK_TOP_K: How many text chunks are kept.

paused.label: Paused
paused.explain: The LLM provider rejected requests (for example budget or rate limit). The run resumes when the pause clears.

hung.label: Hung
hung.explain: The worker is alive but no document has made progress for longer than the hung threshold.

orphaned.label: Orphaned
orphaned.explain: The worker that owned this run has exited. Busy stays set until it is released.

busy_without_run.label: Busy without a run
busy_without_run.explain: The workspace is marked busy but no live run owns it, for example after an upgrade or a crash.

reservation.label: Stranded reservation
reservation.explain: A scan or enqueue reservation has no live owner and blocks email drains. Restart the container to clear it.

stale_doc.label: Stale document
stale_doc.explain: The document has been in progress for longer than the stale-document threshold.

unresponsive.label: Unresponsive
unresponsive.explain: The worker process exists but has stopped sending heartbeats.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.explain: The state of this run could not be determined.

error.forbidden: Admin access required. Your session may lack the admin role.
error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.not_found: Not found. The server may be running an older version.
error.conflict: The state changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unavailable: The service is unavailable. A dependency may be down.
error.refCopyFailed: Could not copy the request ID

refusal.in_progress_by: Another admin is already acting on this workspace.
refusal.lock_unavailable: The workspace lock could not be taken within 2 seconds. If it stays held, restart the container.
refusal.refused_paused: Refused: a provider pause is active.
refusal.not_busy: Nothing to cancel: the pipeline is not busy.
refusal.nothing_pending: Nothing is waiting in the email queue.

refusal.probe_failed: The check could not be run. Try again; if it keeps failing, see the server log.

manager_rtt.title: Shared state is slow to answer

pg_probe.runbook: Check the Postgres container and its connections.

pg_pool_wait.title: Waiting for database connections

pg_blocked.title: Blocked database queries
pg_blocked.runbook: Open the Postgres dependency for the blocking query.

dependency_down.title: A dependency is down

vllm_waiting.title: vLLM queue is long
vllm_waiting.runbook: Compare with LightRAG's own call rate before blaming LightRAG load.

llm_error_rate_15m.title: LLM error rate is high
llm_error_rate_15m.runbook: Check the provider's status and the key's spend limit. Cost is in Token Insights.

llm_p95_15m.title: LLM calls are slow
llm_p95_15m.runbook: Compare with the provider's status page.

provider_paused.title_one: {{countText}} workspace paused by the LLM provider
provider_paused.title_other: {{countText}} workspaces paused by the LLM provider

run_orphaned.title: Run orphaned
run_orphaned.runbook: Release busy, then run the pipeline again.

run_hung.title: Run hung

reservation_without_owner.title: Stranded reservation
reservation_without_owner.runbook: Restart the container to clear it.

stale_docs.runbook: Open Stuck to see which workspaces they belong to.

failure_spike.title: More failures than usual
failure_spike.runbook: Open Failures and group by kind.

email_queue_stalled.title: Email queue is not draining

email_queue_bad.runbook: The drainer skips .bad files; check the server logs for the cause.

email_ingest_silence.title: No emails received for a while
email_ingest_silence.runbook: Check the email connector, not LightRAG.

unauth_warning_lines_5m.title: Warnings from unauthenticated requests
unauth_warning_lines_5m.runbook: Look for a scanner or a misconfigured client.

log_sink_or_recorder_drops_5m.title: Records are being dropped
log_sink_or_recorder_drops_5m.runbook: Check database health and write volume.

llm.label: LLM provider
llm.role: Answers extraction, keyword, query and vision calls.
llm.watch: Passive only, so no paid test calls: error rate, latency and provider rejections from the usage table.

smtp.label: SMTP
smtp.role: Sends provider, budget and operations alert emails.
smtp.watch: EHLO, STARTTLS and NOOP every 15 minutes. No mail is sent.

browser.label: Admins and users
browser.role: Everyone reaches the WebUI and the API through the server's HTTP stack.
browser.watch: The Operations tab polls /admin/ops only for the visible view and pauses while the browser tab is hidden.

connector.label: Email connector
connector.role: Posts emails to /documents/email. Re-sent emails are deferred to the queue directory.
connector.watch: Email queue depth, the oldest record and drain attempts per workspace (Processing › Email queue).

clients.label: API clients
clients.watch: Request IDs on every response; HTTP latency per route arrives with the Performance release.

proxy.label: Reverse proxy
proxy.role: Terminates TLS and forwards requests to LightRAG. It may also route callers straight to vLLM.
proxy.watch: A TLS certificate expiry check every 15 minutes. Its own logs are out of scope.

http.label: HTTP stack
http.role: Uvicorn, the middleware (request ID, usage context, security headers, CORS) and the routers.
http.watch: Every response carries X-Request-ID, and error messages show it as Ref:.

opsapi.label: /admin/ops API
opsapi.role: The endpoints behind this console, admin-only for the whole router.
opsapi.watch: Short per-process caches keep the cost flat however many admins watch. It never loads a workspace into memory.

pipeline.label: Ingestion pipeline
pipeline.role: Parses documents, extracts entities with the LLM and merges them into the graph and vector stores. One run per workspace at a time.
pipeline.watch: Active runs, stuck documents and failures (Processing).

drainer.label: Email re-sync drainers
drainer.role: Apply deferred email bundles in batches, with backoff while the workspace is busy.
drainer.watch: Per-workspace attempts and last result (Processing › Email queue); live drainers per worker (Workers).

insights.label: Insights recorder
insights.role: Writes one usage row per LLM call for Token Insights and the LLM health numbers here.
insights.watch: Buffer, last flush, lost rows and dropped events from each worker's heartbeat.

collectors.label: Ops collectors
collectors.role: Every process writes its own heartbeat. One leased copy per host runs the probes (30 s) and the attention check.
collectors.watch: Switch to the Monitoring layer to see what they write and what they probe.

queue.label: Queue directory
queue.role: One file per deferred email bundle under the working directory.
queue.watch: Counted without opening files, so email contents never reach the console.

postgres.label: PostgreSQL
postgres.role: KV storage, document status, Insights usage tables and the operations tables.
postgres.watch: SELECT 1 latency on a dedicated connection; connections against the limit and blocked queries every 5 minutes.

graph.label: Graph store
graph.watch: A connectivity check on its own driver every 30 seconds.

vector.label: Vector store
vector.role: Vector storage for chunks, entities and relations.
vector.watch: A health check on its own client every 30 seconds. Synchronous client calls also show up as event-loop lag on the workers.

etcd.label: etcd
etcd.watch: Not probed directly. A Milvus health failure is the signal.

minio.label: MinIO
minio.watch: Not probed directly. A Milvus health failure is the signal.

vembed.label: Embeddings
vembed.watch: /health, plus running, waiting and KV cache from /metrics when it is readable. Waiting includes callers outside LightRAG.

vrerank.label: Reranker
vrerank.watch: /health, plus running, waiting and KV cache from /metrics when it is readable. Waiting includes callers outside LightRAG.

docling.label: Docling
docling.role: Parses PDF, Office and other rich documents.

worker.singleNote: One Uvicorn process. Rows from earlier boots stay visible as superseded for 24 hours, so a restart can be traced.

pg.none: No Postgres numbers yet. They are read every 5 minutes.

config.note: URLs carry no credentials and secrets are redacted on the server. Changes need a restart.

blocking.title: Blocked and blocking sessions
blocking.none: No blocked sessions at the last check.

note.vllm: Waiting counts every caller of this endpoint, including any that reach it directly through the proxy. Compare it with LightRAG's own call rate before blaming LightRAG load.
note.milvus: Milvus depends on etcd and MinIO; check those containers too. Its client calls are synchronous, so while it hangs the workers' event-loop lag rises.
note.vector: Vector store calls can block the event loop while the store is slow; check the workers' loop lag too.
note.llm: Passive check: no paid test call is made. Health comes from real calls in the usage table: error rate, latency and provider rejections.
note.smtp: The probe and the test connect, say EHLO, STARTTLS and NOOP, then quit. No mail is ever sent.
note.postgres: Probed on a dedicated connection, so a busy pool does not hide the database's own latency.
